api.note: Bexar County (not BCAD) ArcGIS REST Parcels service built from BCAD data; public service directory. No BCAD-run API.

pricing.note: No fee schedule published; request form says electronic data costs come by written request.

changelog.note: Only public notices and news releases; no data release notes. The county parcel service lists its own last and next update dates.
